summary.text: Lucy Weber is a Democratic state representative from Cheshire District 5 in the New Hampshire House of Representatives and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia, which lists her as Lucy McVitty Weber, lists her career experience as including teaching, practicing law and owning the Walpole Inn.

paragraphs.text: Lucy McVitty Weber earned a bachelor's degree from Tufts University in 1974 and a master's degree and juris doctor from Vermont Law School in 1985.
Her career experience includes owning the Walpole Inn and working as a teacher and attorney.
She has served as president of the Friends of the Walpole Town Library and as a guardian ad litem.
Weber's Ballotpedia profile gives her tenure in the New Hampshire House of Representatives as beginning in 2006, with her current service dated from December 7, 2022.

For 2023-2024 she was assigned to the Health, Human Services and Elderly Affairs Committee and the Rules Committee, and she chaired the Health, Human Services and Elderly Affairs Committee in 2019-2020.
Weber advanced from the Democratic primary on September 8, 2026, and is on the November 3 ballot for Cheshire 5.
